groups.title: Nonadverbialized domain and time relations
groups.proposal: Compose explicit and context-derived time relations from exact principal and adjoined Results.
groups.readingJob: Show clause rank, time profile, order, adverbial indicator, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Users capture exact units and choose only a licensed time profile; tense facts remain derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not infer relation or tense from translation or displayed word order.

groups.title: Place relations
groups.proposal: Compose place relations from exact captured clauses or NNC Results.
groups.readingJob: Show captured units, relation, degree, order, and finite surface.
groups.decisionSplit: The relation is available only when the owner licenses the captured units.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not reconstruct a place Source from the final sentence.

groups.title: Manner relations
groups.proposal: Compose nonadverbialized manner relations without conflating them with compared-manner word formation.
groups.readingJob: Show manner scope, captured unit kind, order, and contrast with adverbialized manner.
groups.decisionSplit: The typed route distinguishes clause adjunction from word formation.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not use a similar English translation to merge distinct routes.

groups.title: Consideration relations
groups.proposal: Apply consideration as a typed adjunction relation while preserving its intransitive-principal constraints.
groups.readingJob: Show the consideration profile, principal valence, adjoined unit, and contrast.
groups.decisionSplit: Only owner-compatible captured Results expose consideration.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not override principal valence with saved UI state.

groups.title: Purpose relations
groups.proposal: Compose unmarked, ma-optative, admonitive-lest, purposive-VNC, and weak purpose profiles from exact Results.
groups.readingJob: Show purpose type, mood, marker, order, polarity, and finite Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Purpose type and required marker are selected only where typed mood and Source permit them.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not infer purpose from English infinitive wording.

groups.title: Condition relations
groups.proposal: Compose open and hypothetical conditions with exact marker, mood, tense, future-embed, and antecessive alignment.
groups.readingJob: Show condition type, tla marker, mood, tense, antecedent scope, order, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Condition type is genuine; mood, tense, and antecessive compatibility are owner-validated.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not reconstruct a marker or antecessive from a displayed sentence.

groups.title: Concession relations
groups.proposal: Compose in-tla-nel, in-ma-nel, ma-zo, ma-zo-tel, and at-least concession profiles with exact particles.
groups.readingJob: Show concessive family, marker identity, polarity, intensification, tel, za/zan distinction, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: The concessive profile is available only with its licensed exact marker Result.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not authorize a marker from its spelling or translation.

groups.title: Consequence relations
groups.proposal: Compose consequence through the exact typed adverbial iuh Result.
groups.readingJob: Show iuh Source identity, consequence scope, order, and finite Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Consequence becomes available from compatible captures; iuh identity is not freely selected.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not substitute an arbitrary surface resembling iuh.

groups.title: Proviso relations
groups.proposal: Compose proviso with the exact negativized ahzo marker and sentence Result.
groups.readingJob: Show sentence capture, ahzo marker identity, negative scope, order, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: The proviso route requires its canonical marker; spelling is not a shortcut.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not treat arbitrary negative particles as proviso markers.

groups.title: Reason relations
groups.proposal: Compose reason with an exact sentence Result and ca particle while preserving ca as a principal-clause introducer rather than a conjunction.
groups.readingJob: Show sentence capture, ca marker, head/modifier order, translation mirage, and Result.
groups.decisionSplit: The reason relation and order are choices where licensed; ca's grammatical role is derived.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not let English conjunction translation redefine ca.
